$comment: What CI does with each example, and the only place that says it. scripts/serve-and-assert.mjs is the single reader of `build`, `start`, `port` and `assertRender`; every workflow in .github/workflows calls it with a directory name and keeps no copy of any of this. Edit an entry here and CI follows. An `assertRender` item is a path, or an object with that `path` plus `lang` when the URL also has to prove which language it served , `elements` when tags have to be on it - `header` and `footer` are the layout regions, and nothing else notices a page that renders none - and `status` when the URL is meant to answer something other than 200. `assertSitemap` turns on scripts/assert-sitemap.mjs, which checks that every URL the sitemap lists is a URL the app serves. `buildOnly` is a debt marker, not a category - the script skips such an example and prints `buildOnlyReason`, every example is meant to end up asserted, and the marker names what has to happen for it to go away.

examples.$assertComment: No `elements` on the 404: this example answers 404 correctly but streams the body client-side, so the served HTML carries neither region. astro and remix render theirs server-side and are asserted for it.
